title: Randomized Controlled Trial of a Community Health Worker Program on Hearing Loss (Oyendo Bien)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the effectiveness of a community health worker intervention to expand access to hearing health care among older adults facing health disparities.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Minimum age: 50 years
* Audiometrically-confirmed hearing loss
* Availability of a communication partner to attend the program with the participant
* Be Spanish speaking and able to sign written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cognitive impairment
